versions.changelog:
- Initial release of uas-ops-checker.
- Provides a compliance classification tool for drone (UAS) operations based on official rules (TH-UAS-001 domain).
- Outputs decision results in JSON IR format with clear error codes.
- Includes built-in demo cases and parameter-based judgment.
- Rule sources include 《无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例》(国务院令761号,2024) and CCAR-92.
- For decision support only—results require manual verification and do not constitute legal advice.
